blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman on Friday said it ordered the preventive suspension of five project engineers of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) amid its ongoing investigation involving three flood control projects in Bulacan. In a statement, the ombudsman identified the five engineers as Irene Ontingco, Kevin Geronimo, John Michael Ramos, Bernardo Villafuerte, and Michelle Cruz, who were part of the DPWH Bulacan First District. The five were placed under preventive suspension without pay for a period not exceeding six months “pending the resolution of administrative cases against them,” the ombudsman said.
